novel_features.name: Bilingual source identity
novel_features.description: Match first-party English and Japanese restaurant identities by source ID with bounded native filters.
novel_features.rationale: Joins language variants by source ID rather than guessing translations.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when Japanese identity must remain traceable to a public restaurant.

novel_features.name: Fee conflict preservation
novel_features.description: Keep per-guest and per-group JPY prices and conflicting course and restaurant fee statements without inventing a payable total.
novel_features.rationale: Keeps both source contexts visible rather than flattening fees into a misleading sum.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before comparing budgets when inclusions and policy charges disagree.

novel_features.name: Validated canonical handoff
novel_features.description: Validate course and session ownership and party bounds before returning the canonical restaurant link.
novel_features.rationale: Combines public course and session identity checks with a read-only first-party handoff.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to hand a verified restaurant choice to a diner without creating a reservation.

narrative.headline: Discover fine dining with sourced courses, session identity and safe booking handoff.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public discovery needs no account or paid key. Complete any booking on the provider website.
